title.zh: Shadowrocket 进阶配置：分流规则模式（Config）、代理分组与分应用按需代理实战
title.en: Advanced Shadowrocket: Config Routing Rules, Proxy Policy Groups & Per-App On-Demand Routing

description.zh: 掌握 iOS 小火箭高级路由分流与策略组配置。教你如何导入 ACL4SSR 等第三方远程规则集、配置按需代理（On Demand）、为特定境外应用绑定专属专线节点及实现海量国内 App 零耗流量直连。
description.en: Master advanced Shadowrocket routing configurations. Learn to import remote rule-sets like ACL4SSR, configure On Demand cellular triggers, assign dedicated proxy groups to AI/streaming apps, and optimize domestic direct routes.
